identification: Bundle of unframed reproduction prints of Tasmania, loose sheets on card mounts: colour views (Ben Lomond-type mountain landscape, Hobart Town from hillside, ships in Hobart harbour, Hobart township with church spire), grey lithograph views (basalt cliffs with sailing ship, Hobart with Mt Wellington), a colonial uniform plate (Regimental Quartermaster Sergeant, Tasmanian volunteers), a sepia photographic print of Barn Bluff reflected in tarn, and a bird's-eye engraving of Hobart. All appear to be modern reproductions of colonial views, not originals.
